package handler

import (
	sender "GENRE_MODULE/game/handler/syncsender"
	"GENRE_MODULE/game/modules/robotaccess"
	robotdomain "GENRE_MODULE/game/modules/towerdefense"
	bots "GENRE_MODULE/loadtest"
	"GENRE_MODULE/protocol/pb"
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/network/gateway"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/runner"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/transport"
	"net"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestTowerDefenseRobotBusiness(t *testing.T) {
	f := newTowerFixture(t)
	auth := gateway.AuthenticatorFunc(func(_ context.Context, ticket string, _ net.Addr) (gateway.Principal, error) {
		switch ticket {
		case "owner":
			return gateway.Principal{PlayerID: f.ids[0], SessionID: "owner", ServerID: 1}, nil
		case "outsider":
			return gateway.Principal{PlayerID: 999999, SessionID: "outsider", ServerID: 1}, nil
		default:
			for i, id := range f.ids {
				if ticket == fmt.Sprintf("seat-%d", i) {
					return gateway.Principal{PlayerID: id, SessionID: ticket, ServerID: 1}, nil
				}
			}
			return gateway.Principal{}, gateway.ErrUnauthenticated
		}
	})
	cfg := gateway.DefaultTCPConfig()
	cfg.Addr = "127.0.0.1:0"
	server, err := gateway.NewTCPServer(cfg, robotaccess.Dispatch(f.engine), auth)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = server.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		if err := server.Stop(ctx); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	run := func(ticket string, steps []bots.Step) {
		t.Helper()
		r := bots.Commands(runner.Config{Count: 1, Duration: 5 * time.Second, Transport: transport.Config{Endpoint: server.Addr().String()}}, func(*robot.Context) (*transport.Packet, error) { return transport.AuthPacket(ticket), nil }, steps)
		if err := r.Run(context.Background()); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if s := r.Stats(); s.Success != 1 || s.Failure != 0 || s.Canceled != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("robot: %+v", s)
		}
	}
	// 每条新的 TCP 连接先接管席位：带这个席位当前的代际发 reconnect（room 的 RoomReconnect，CAS 分配 EpochSeed+1），
	// 之后的命令带新代际。旧代际的命令（包括原样重放）被 room 的代际围栏拒绝。
	takeover := func(i int) (pb.PlayRequest, uint64) {
		t.Helper()
		v := robotRead(t, f.engine, f.match, func() [2]uint64 {
			seat, _ := f.match.Dao().GetSeats(f.ids[i])
			return [2]uint64{seat.GetEpoch(), f.match.Dao().GetEpochSeed()}
		})
		return pb.PlayRequest{Kind: "reconnect", RoomID: f.match.ID(), Epoch: v[0]}, v[1] + 1
	}
	// next 是席位 i 的下一条命令：序号与回合取自已提交的状态（视图要当前连接，Robot 接管之后夹具的连接已经旧了）。
	next := func(i int, epoch uint64, kind string, a, b int) pb.PlayRequest {
		t.Helper()
		s := robotDecode(t, f.engine, f.match, f.match.Dao().GetTowerState, robotdomain.Decode)
		return pb.PlayRequest{RoomID: f.match.ID(), Seq: uint64(len(s.Seats[i].Receipts) + 1), Epoch: epoch, Round: int32(s.Round), Kind: kind, A: int32(a), B: int32(b)}
	}
	take, epoch := takeover(0)
	first := next(0, epoch, "build", 1, 0)
	again := pb.PlayRequest{Kind: "reconnect", RoomID: f.match.ID(), Epoch: epoch}
	second := first
	second.Seq++
	second.Epoch = epoch + 1
	second.Kind = "upgrade"
	second.B = 1
	invalid := second
	invalid.Seq++
	invalid.Kind = "not-a-command"
	run("owner", []bots.Step{{Request: take}, {Request: first}, {Request: first}, {Request: again, Reconnect: true}, {Request: first, WantCode: 1}, {Request: second}, {Request: second}, {Request: invalid, WantCode: 1}})
	state := robotDecode(t, f.engine, f.match, f.match.Dao().GetTowerState, robotdomain.Decode)
	if len(state.Seats[0].Receipts) != 2 || state.Towers[1].Owner != f.ids[0] || state.Towers[1].Level != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("wrong committed business state: %+v", state)
	}
	before := robotRead(t, f.engine, f.match, func() string { return f.match.Dao().GetTowerState() })
	run("outsider", []bots.Step{{Request: take, WantCode: 1}, {Request: second, WantCode: 1}})
	if robotRead(t, f.engine, f.match, func() string { return f.match.Dao().GetTowerState() }) != before {
		t.Fatal("unauthorized command changed authoritative state")
	}

	for i, cell := range []int{1, 6, 11, 16} {
		seat := fmt.Sprintf("seat-%d", i)
		if i > 0 {
			take, epoch := takeover(i)
			run(seat, []bots.Step{{Request: take}, {Request: next(i, epoch, "build", cell, 0)}})
		}
		take, epoch := takeover(i)
		run(seat, []bots.Step{{Request: take}, {Request: next(i, epoch, "ready", 0, 0)}})
	}
	// 席位 0 交还夹具的连接（同样是带代际的 RoomReconnect），之后 f.view / f.step 照常用。
	back, _ := takeover(0)
	if _, err := sender.NewRoomReconnectSender(f.engine).Sync_RoomReconnect(context.Background(), f.match.ID(), f.ids[0], back.Epoch, f.conns[0]); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for range 100 {
		if f.view(t, 0).Phase == "done" {
			break
		}
		f.step(t)
	}
	if f.view(t, 0).Result != "won" {
		t.Fatal("cooperative waves not won")
	}
	claim := pb.PlayRequest{Kind: "claim", RoomID: f.match.ID()}
	for i := range f.ids {
		run(fmt.Sprintf("seat-%d", i), []bots.Step{{Request: claim}, {Request: claim, Reconnect: true}})
		if robotRead(t, f.engine, f.players[i], func() int64 { return f.players[i].Dao().GetWallet().GetCoins() }) != 70 {
			t.Fatal("team payout duplicated or missing")
		}
	}
	run("outsider", []bots.Step{{Request: claim, WantCode: 1}})

}
